explication: ESP32 Bit Pirate is ESP32 firmware for protocol development, analysis, and device interaction. Its primary workflow is user input through a serial or Wi-Fi web terminal, command dispatch into a mode-specific controller, then protocol operations and terminal or device-view output. The repository also contains board-specific interfaces, shared state, analyzers, and network tools. Relationships are limited to those shown in excerpts or documented in the README; unsampled subsystem links are left out or marked unverified.
